evals.description: Validates static APK auditing via REA (DEX, lib/*.so, v1-v3.1 signatures), placebo security detection (isDeviceRooted -> false), and CVE remediation.
evals.prompt: Execute uma auditoria re-a-ndroid completa no APK app-release.apk usando REA: descompile o DEX e bibliotecas .so, verifique a assinatura v2/v3, procure funções placebo de root/token e aponte CVEs nas dependências.

evals.description: Validates live ADB inspection (am start -W, uiautomator dump, dumpsys gfxinfo), A_rate/T_ratio (>= 48x48dp) calculus, and Haptic Feedback verification.
evals.prompt: Audit package com.example.finapp live via ADB and re-a-ndroid: measure Cold Start latency, extract window_dump.xml to validate contentDescription and 48x48dp touch targets, and check haptics and orphan routes.

evals.description: Validates deterministic computation of all 6 math indicators (Pass@k, L_cold, M_rotas, A_rate, T_ratio, FNR) and Self-Refine report format.
evals.prompt: Generate the RE-A-NDROID Audit Report consolidating SEC-01, PLC-01, ACC-01, PERF-01, and NAV-01 with all 6 mathematical metrics (Pass@k, L_cold, M_rotas, A_rate, T_ratio, FNR < 0.001).

evals.description: Near-miss: request solely to scaffold a brand-new greenfield Android MVP with AGP 9 Built-in Kotlin and Compose BOM without APK reverse engineering.

evals.description: Near-miss: request to inspect WAI-ARIA and 44px touch targets on a React/Next.js web application.
